nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What was the role of X-ray CT scanning in the experimental program?
nodes.answer: X-ray CT scanning was used to observe the cracking propagation inside the concrete at the meso-scale.
nodes.paragraph: After FTCs, wedge-splitting and com- pression tests were performed, accompanied by DIC, to investigate the interactive effects of pre- damage, water boundary conditions and internal frost damage on tensile strength, fracture behav - iour and compressive strength of concrete at the macro-scale. Subsequently, X-ray CT scanning was applied on drilled cores to observe the crack - ing propagation inside the concrete at the meso- scale. The findings of this study contribute to the field of structural and construction engineering by offering insights that can inform the design of more resilient concrete structures in cold regions and the development of maintenance strategies for concrete components.2 Experimental program The experimental program consisted of four parts: preparation, Freeze-Thaw Cycles (FTC), mechanical testing (macro-scale) and X-ray CT imaging (meso- scale) During the preparation stage of the specimens (from casting till the start of FTCs), pre-damage in the form of pre-cracking or pre-compressive damage was applied to some of the specimens. Pre-cracking mimics existing surface cracks in structures, corre- sponding to scenarios such as beams or slabs cracked due to bending and drying.

nodes.question: What is the time frame mentioned for observing the TSS plume after the dam breach?
nodes.answer: The TSS plume was observed between 9 June and 2 July 2023.
nodes.paragraph: The water level in Kakhovka Reservoir was around 17.5 m above sea level before explosion, and around 90% of the reservoir was drained after dam breach.
